_comments: THE AUTOMATION OUTBOX SWEEP. MJ's SchedulingEngine is the mechanism — no external cron.
· CronExpression `*/30 * * * * *` — SIX fields, seconds first: every 30 seconds. A first
attempt does not wait for it (the submitting process drains its own events after commit);
the sweep runs retries once their backoff has passed and recovers events a dead process
left Running once their 120-second lease expires.
· ConcurrencyMode Skip — overlapping sweeps would only contend for the same claims. The
claim itself is atomic, so this is economy, not correctness.
· MissedRunPolicy RunOnce — one sweep drains everything due; replaying missed ticks would not.
OwnerUserID and NotifyUserID are left NULL: naming a person here would seed one deployment's
staff into another's database. Configuration is empty: the driver takes none. No sync block.

fields.Name: Forms — Automation Outbox Sweep (every 30 s)
fields.Description: Runs MJ Forms on-submit automations that are due: retries after their backoff, and events a stopped process left behind. First attempts run in the submitting process right after commit and do not wait for this sweep.
